expectations.text: States the 'Essentials' consultation (evolution/expansion of the Essential Eight) closed July 12, 2026
expectations.evidence: The 'Essentials' consultation and its July 12, 2026 close date are never mentioned; only "sector chatter" about a possible ninth strategy

expectations.text: States that no outcome had been announced as of early September 2026 — the consultation proposed Essentials for enterprise IT as a first chapter with E8 deprecation ~12 months and retirement ~24 months after finalisation
expectations.evidence: No statement about the consultation or its proposed enterprise-IT chapter and deprecation/retirement timelines; response disclaims post-cutoff knowledge

expectations.text: Concludes the Essential Eight and its Maturity Model remain the operative assessment standard today
expectations.evidence: "the Essential Eight was not being retired or replaced — it remained ASD/ACSC's baseline mitigation strategy framework"; advises assessing against it as baseline

expectations.text: Advises continuing E8 maturity assessments while tracking ASD announcements
expectations.evidence: "Assess against Essential Eight maturity levels as your baseline" and "Re-run your gap assessment whenever ACSC issues an update"

expectations.text: Notes ISM quarterly releases are separate from E8 maturity workstreams (September controls carry no E8 mappings claim, or equivalent separation point)
expectations.evidence: No separation point between ISM quarterly releases and E8 maturity workstreams; instead says ISM guidelines "explicitly map back to Essential Eight maturity levels"
